# Ponytail for DeepSeek Harness
English | 中文

Ponytail is "lazy senior dev
mode": the smallest change that fully solves the task, and a reply a bu

sy human
understands in one read. This bundle ports it to DeepSeek Harness as one
pluggable unit — s

witch it on and it applies to every session. There is no slash
command to remember.
## What you get (bundle on = on)

- **Always-on rules.** A prompt section (`ponytail:rules`, order 9500) carries
`PONYTAIL MODE ACTIVE

— level: <level>` plus the canonical rules, re-read at
every step assembly, for every session in th

is profile, subagents included.
- **Six skills.** The session catalog tells the model to load a skil

l when a
request matches, so "review this change" reaches `ponytail-review` without any
gesture. The

five task skills can also be typed as `/ponytail-review`,
`/ponytail-audit`, `/ponytail-debt`, `/po

nytail-gain`, `/ponytail-help`; the
core `ponytail` skill stays model-only.
- **A configured level.*

* `defaultMode` in the row config: `off`, `lite`,
`full` (default) or `ultra`. No command and no sta

te file: turn the bundle on
and the configured level is what runs.
- **Deactivation phrases.** A who

le message that is exactly "stop ponytail" or
"normal mode" ends the rules for this process run, as

upstream does; a bundle
toggle or restart restores the configured level.
## Levels
| `defaultMode` | Behavior |

| `off` | No rules injected; the six skills still load on demand. |
| `lite` | Build what was asked;

name the smaller option in one line. |
| `full` | The rules above. Default. |
| `ultra` | Also ques
tion the request before building. |
## Install

Pick any route; all of them install the same bundle (a package with a
`dsh.bundle.patch`).
| Route | Spec to give **Plugins → Add plugin** (or `dsh plugin add`) |

| GitHub | `github:Vincent-chk/dsh-ponytail` |
| Git URL | `https://github.com/Vincent-chk/dsh-ponyt

ail` |
| Tarball | `npm pack` in a checkout, then the absolute path to the `.tgz` |
| Local checkout
| the absolute path of this directory |

**From the plugin market:** add this index source in
**Plugins → Discover → Add index source** and i
nstall from the card:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`npm publish` is prepared in PUBLISHING.md; the package is not
on npm yet.

> **Not the npm package named `dsh-ponytail`.** This bundle is
> `@dsh-ext/dsh-ponytail` and install

s from this repository or the index above.
> An unrelated npm package uses the bare name `dsh-ponyta

il` and targets an old
> DSH generation; installing it fails with a compatibility error (see
> Troub

ets an old
> DSH generation; installing it fails with a compatibility error (see
> Troubleshooting).

Toggling the bundle off in the Plugins page removes the rules and all six
skills; toggling it back o

dle off in the Plugins page removes the rules and all six
skills; toggling it back on restores them.
## Change the level

Add an override row to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` — the loader replaces
the row's complete `co
nfig`, so restate the level you want:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

HMR recomposes on the patch change; if it does not, toggle the bundle off and on
in the Plugins page

. `PONYTAIL_DEFAULT_MODE` overrides the row config. Resolution
order: `PONYTAIL_DEFAULT_MODE` > row
`defaultMode` > `full`.
## Not ported, on purpose

- The Claude Code statusline/band and the local HTML board: DeepSeek Harness
already shows token and

cache usage, and the band is a Claude-private API.
- The `/ponytail` level command and its state fi

le: the bundle switch is the
control, and the level is deployment configuration. The upstream senten

ce in
the rules was adapted to say so.
- Per-project levels: the level is process-wide. `shortcut:`

the upgrade path is
registering the section per `agent.ctx` keyed by session cwd.
- `/ponytail defau
lt <mode>`: the default is row config, not a command.
## Verify

`npm test` runs two checks: `test/selfcheck.mjs` asserts the level grammar,
frontmatter parsing, lev

el filtering, deactivation matching, and that all six
bundled assets are complete; `test/bundle-chec

k.mjs` runs the real `apply()`
against a fake Cordis context and asserts the injected rules follow t

he
configured level, no command is registered, no state file is written, the
deactivation listener e

mpties the section, and the skill provider serves all six
skills with registry-valid definitions.

On macOS volumes that store extended attributes as AppleDouble files (exFAT,
some network mounts), a

write beside `locale/*.json` can leave a `._*.json`
companion that the Harness locale reader reject

s as a language file;
`npm run clean:macos` removes them, and the self-check fails until it does.
## Troubleshooting

**`dsh-ponytail@0.2.0` is incompatible with DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 (requires
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent`, `dsh-

commands`, `dsh-llm`, `dsh-settings`, `dsh-skill`,
`dsh-system-prompt` at `^0.1.0-rc.6`)**

That message comes from the unrelated npm package `dsh-ponytail@0.2.0`
(published 2026-08-15, built

for DSH 0.1.0-rc.6), not from this bundle. Uninstall
that package in Plugins, then install this repo

sitory instead:
`github:Vincent-chk/dsh-ponytail`, the Git URL, or the market index above. This
bund

le declares no `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer requirements and its
`engines.dsh` is `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`

e declares no `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer requirements and its
`engines.dsh` is `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`.
